rows.statutoryAuthority: C.R.S. § 24-72-709; Colorado Judicial Department forms JDF 641 and JDF 642
notableDecisions: No cell of section 4's fifteen-row, four-column offence table is written. Which convictions a participant brings under § 24-72-709 is the substance of the motion and the platform does not hold them; the fourth column is the date supervision ended, which is the fact the statutory waiting period runs from, so a row with the charge filled and that date blank would read as finished and be missing what the court needs.

The `∆` field carries two widgets — the page-1 caption and the Print Your Name line in section 10 — so the name is written in both. Section 10 of JDF 641 is a plain signature block, not a verification under penalty of perjury, which is why the printed name is written here and left blank on JDF 477.

JDF 642 prints 'City, State, and Zip Code' and the shared descriptor matches /city\s*state\s*zip/, which the interposed 'and' defeats. The dictionary now carries a separate bindingLabel for the semantics and keeps the form's printed words as the participant-facing label, rather than rewording the caption to suit a regular expression.
findingsRaisedForOthers: JDF 641 and JDF 642 interleave their glyph runs; no printed-caption check can be run on either, and the absence is recorded per field in reports/caption-evidence.json.

The module is at scripts/raster/pdf-page-raster.mjs, and FIFTEEN builders on that branch still import the old path, so none of them can run there: ak-courtview, ak-tf805, co_motion_seal_nonconviction, co_multiple_conviction_seal, co_pardoned_conviction_seal, ky_void_seal_controlled_substance, md_second_chance_shielding, me-seal-prost, mi_setaside_marihuana, or_conviction_setaside, pa_age70_deceased, pa_pardon_expungement, va_seal_petition_misdemeanor, vt_exp_decriminalized, vt_seal_nonconviction. Two builders (ak-tf800, vt_seal_misdemeanor) already import the new path, so the migration is half done. A one-line re-export shim at the old path fixes all fifteen at once. This lane changed only its OWN builders, which now try the new path and fall back to the old, catching ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND and nothing else; the other builders are not this lane's to edit.

BLOCKING for the raster gate, owner of the packet-factory builder contract: assembled packet PDFs are NOT byte-reproducible. PDFDocument.create() stamps /CreationDate and /ModDate from the wall clock, and save({updateMetadata:false}) stops those being refreshed but not being set. Two builds of identical inputs were measured differing in exactly six bytes, all of them timestamp digits. A RASTER_PASS bound to one build's SHA-256 is therefore invalidated by a rebuild that changed nothing, which is the opposite of what a hash-bound gate is for. The fix is two lines before save: setCreationDate(new Date(0)) and setModificationDate(new Date(0)). This lane applied it to the three families no VF lane has been assigned, and proved reproducibility by rebuilding and comparing. It did NOT apply it to its earlier families: VF-SRC-A and VF-SRC-B are reading those now, and moving bytes under a verifier mid-read is worse than leaving a known non-determinism in place for the Captain to sequence.

rows.statutoryAuthority: Alaska Court System form TF-805 (5/25); Alaska Administrative Rule 40(b) and 40(c)
rows.componentsNote: TF-805 prints the request, the sworn verification, the certificate of service and the judge's order on its own two sheets; all three instrument kinds are in the one binary, and the certificate and the order are refused by class rather than filled.
rows.whatChanged: This family existed before this lane. Its production-field-map was written in a schema the completeness verifier refuses as unauditable, and it carried no participant-instructions.md, no byte-proof record and no build status. It now carries a contract-readable map, reports/actual-writes.json read back from the finalized bytes, participant instructions naming every required-before-filing item, page rasters through scripts/lib/pdf-page-raster.mjs, and the builder's own count of the nine counters.
supersededEvidenceRemoved: build-record.json — it recorded the two fixture hashes of the previous build, which these bytes replace.
raster/tf805-{canonical,boundary}/page-0{1,2}.png — the previous build's page rasters, superseded by the calibrated per-page renders now written beside them.
notableDecisions: The choice between the Rule 40(b) ground and the Rule 40(c) ground is a participant election, not a route-determined selection: this packet is built for Rule 40, and which ground fits is a fact about the participant's own case.
The five-year limit on a 40(c) removal is carried into the instructions in the form's own terms, beside the election.

laneNote: The Captain rebased shiftBaseSha to 2e6ca51b at 09:51:26Z, after this lane's families were built on the previous base 09b741ad. The shared machinery this lane depends on is unchanged between the two: completeness-contract.mjs, the finalizer, the field semantics, the anchor capture, the rule lines and the corpus index are all identical, so the counters in these rows were computed against the same contract the new base carries. What DID change is that scripts/lib/pdf-page-raster.mjs moved; see findingsRaisedForOthers. This branch was not reset onto the new base, because resetting would discard five commits of finished, pushed returns and the rebase reason given in the shift file — verifiers rebasing onto a base missing the integration waves — does not apply to a builder whose preflight already reads 15/15.
